comment: mthrowu.c ohitmon() 444-448: a monster-thrown cockatrice egg hits a stone-resistant monster, so munstone()/minstapetrify() leave it alive and the damage is zeroed (448). A debug Valkyrie wishes for three cockatrice eggs and drops them beside a tame djinni (stone resistant, so can_touch_safely() lets it carry them); the djinni picks them up, and when a peaceful gelatinous cube (stone resistant; pets rarely melee it) lines up, thrwmm() selects the egg first (select_rwep Oselect(EGG)) and throws it.
